values.note: Illustrative, representative of Ada-002 / BGE-m3 style embeddings on Milvus 2.6+ (FLAT, FP16/BF16, INT8, IVF_SQ8, IVF_PQ, HNSW_PRQ, IVF_RABITQ). Points are authored at 768-D; the Embedding dim control scales the residual recall error of the dimension-sensitive families (PQ, PRQ, RaBitQ) by 1.10 / 1.00 / 0.90 / 0.82 at 384 / 768 / 1536 / 3072-D. Direction only, not measured. Scalar methods (FP16, BF16, SQ8) quantise each number independently and are held flat. Stage 2 drifts each point along x from nominal payload compression to an approximate production footprint, measured against the IVF_FLAT fp32 index (index structure and segment heap included). SQ8, PQ 8/16/32, RaBitQ and RaBitQ+rerank use the measured 1M, 1024-D footprints from rag-cost-curve/data/ws2/curves_1m.csv (ivf_sq8, ivf_pq_m512/m256/m128, rabitq, rabitq_refine_sq8_k2). FP16, BF16, PQ 4 and PRQ were not measured and use 1/(1/c + 0.04), the overhead the measured IVF arms imply (within ~5% of each); PRQ is HNSW, so its graph overhead is assumed similar. RaBitQ+refine lands at 3.19x because refine keeps an SQ8 copy of every vector in memory. The SQ8 on disk variant (revealed at stage 2) is inferred, not measured: the refine copy is read from disk, so memory footprint is taken as bare RaBitQ (13.98x) and recall as RaBitQ+refine, at the cost of disk reads per query. Recall is not moved.

transform.expr: (datum.series == 'PQ' || datum.series == 'PRQ' || indexof(datum.series, 'RaBitQ') >= 0) ? 1 - (1 - datum.recall) * (dim == '384' ? 1.10 : dim == '1536' ? 0.90 : dim == '3072' ? 0.82 : 1) : datum.recall

x2.signal: scale('x', datum.compression) + (scale('x', datum.prod) - scale('x', datum.compression)) * drift

tooltip.signal: {"Quantisation": isValid(datum["series"]) ? isArray(datum["series"]) ? join(datum["series"], '\n') : datum["series"] : ""+datum["series"], "Recall@10": format(datum["recall_adj"], ".2f"), "Compression": format(datum["compression"], "")}

x.signal: scale('x', datum.compression) + (scale('x', datum.prod) - scale('x', datum.compression)) * drift

text.signal: (datum.variant ? 'RaBitQ + refine, ' + datum.variant : datum.series) + ' · ' + format(datum.recall_adj, '.2f') + ' @ 1/' + (drift > 0 ? format(datum.compression + (datum.prod - datum.compression) * drift, '.1f') : datum.compression)

x.signal: scale('x', datum.compression) + (scale('x', datum.prod) - scale('x', datum.compression)) * drift

dy.signal: datum.variant ? -22 : stage >= 2 && datum.series == 'PQ' && datum.compression == 8 ? 14 : datum.series == 'FP32 (FLAT)' ? -18 : datum.series == 'FP16' ? -6 : datum.series == 'BF16' ? 12 : 0

text.signal: (datum.variant ? 'RaBitQ + refine, ' + datum.variant : datum.series) + ' · ' + format(datum.recall_adj, '.2f') + ' @ 1/' + (drift > 0 ? format(datum.compression + (datum.prod - datum.compression) * drift, '.1f') : datum.compression)

x.signal: scale('x', datum.compression) + (scale('x', datum.prod) - scale('x', datum.compression)) * drift

dy.signal: datum.variant ? -22 : stage >= 2 && datum.series == 'PQ' && datum.compression == 8 ? 14 : datum.series == 'FP32 (FLAT)' ? -18 : datum.series == 'FP16' ? -6 : datum.series == 'BF16' ? 12 : 0
